## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] test — adds or updates tests
- [ ] chore — tooling, build, ci

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (e.g. `feat(auth): add JWT login`).
- [ ] Targets `develop` (not `main`, unless this is a release/hotfix).
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing locally.
- [ ] Coverage on domain modules ≥ 80%.
- [ ] `ruff` and `black --check` pass.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or passwords in the diff.
- [ ] Updated `docs/` if public behavior changed.
